messages.content: 尋找位於法國巴黎和美國紐約的至少有4顆星評級的酒店。我也偏好有免費WiFi、包含早餐和健身設施的酒店。

function.name: hotel_find
function.description: Search for hotels given the location, minimum stars and specific amenities. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city where you want to find the hotel

stars.description: Minimum number of stars the hotel should have. Default 1

items.description: Preferred amenities in hotel. Here are a list of possible option : 'Free WiFi', 'Breakfast Included', 'Gym', 'Free Parking'

amenities.description: List of preferred amenities in hotel. Default to empty array

function.name: flight_search
function.description: Search for flights given the origin, destination, date, and number of passengers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

date.description: The date of the flight. Default ''
